speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that information. To help narrow down the cause, can you tell me if the spinning sensation was triggered by changing your head position, such as rolling over in bed or looking up? Additionally, did you experience any hearing changes or tinnitus in one ear?

text: Since the episode was brief, triggered by going to bed, and lacks auditory or neurological symptoms, BPPV is highly likely. I will perform a physical exam to confirm this. REQUEST TEST: Dix-Hallpike_Manoeuvre
